vendor.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams announces data delivery to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets
vendor.teaser: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now delivers streaming data directly to general purpose Amazon S3 buckets, providing the easiest way to ingest and deliver streaming data to S3 without building or managing delivery pipelines.

vendor.title: Supporting Thailand’s next generation of AI startups
vendor.teaser: OpenAI and Thailand’s MHESI launch an eight-week accelerator helping 10 health, wellness, and education startups turn AI prototypes into trusted products.

vendor.title: AWS Transform now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
vendor.teaser: The AWS Transform service is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C (formerly Moderate baseline) in the US East (N. Virginia) Region.

vendor.title: LLMs Are Not (Consistently) Bayesian: Quantifying Internal (In)consistencies of LLMs’ Probabilistic Beliefs
vendor.teaser: Modern AI systems are being deployed in complex domains such as medicine, science, and law, where there is often not a single correct answer given the observed evidence.

vendor.title: Agent Seer: Synthesizing Scenarios from Specification Understanding
vendor.teaser: Evaluating AI agents that use external tools requires realistic test scenarios that capture how practitioners compose tools and iterate across conversation turns.

vendor.title: Three Perfect Days at Dreamforce — A Marketer’s Guide
vendor.teaser: Looking to make the most out of Dreamforce 2026? Then this guide is for you.

vendor.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams announces streaming tables, delivering data to Apache Iceberg tables on Amazon S3 Tables
vendor.teaser: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams introduces streaming tables, a new fully serverless capability that continuously delivers data from Kinesis streams to Amazon S3 Tables in Apache Iceberg format.

vendor.title: Should you still care about translation quality?
vendor.teaser: Discover why AI translation benchmark scores miss what truly impacts business growth, brand voice, and long-term translation accuracy.

vendor.title: SpaceXAI Grok 4.6 now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
vendor.teaser: Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.6, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work. Grok 4.6 is SpaceXAI’s latest flagship model, built for long-running agents and ambitious interactive and visual work.

vendor.title: Builder spotlight: John Cole won $20,000 on Apify without a CS degree
vendor.teaser: Nearly 100 Actors, 15K users, and a battery of tests behind every one. How a self-taught builder took second in the Apify $1 Million Challenge.

stories.title: AIMX Singapore 2026 Accelerates AI Deployment Through Catalysing Industry Innovation and Advancing Global Collaborations
stories.teaser: AIMX Singapore 2026 is a major artificial intelligence conference bringing together business leaders, policymakers, and technology innovators from more than 60 countries to Singapore. The event will be opened by Singapore's Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and will feature discussions on practical AI adoption across industries including healthcare, robotics, logistics, and retail.

stories.title: In a divided America, the left and right unite to oppose artificial intelligence data centers
stories.teaser: Across the United States, an unusual political coalition has emerged opposing artificial intelligence data center development, uniting conservative farmers, environmental groups, and communities concerned about farmland loss, water depletion, and rising electricity costs. This opposition spans traditionally Republican areas like Nebraska, Texas, and Wyoming, as well as Democratic regions like New Mexico and…

stories.title: Poll: Americans want stronger rules for AI in schools
stories.teaser: A new poll conducted by The Century Foundation reveals that American voters across the political spectrum support stricter government regulations on artificial intelligence in K-12 schools. The survey of over 2,000 registered voters found that 77% of Americans want stronger rules limiting AI use in classrooms, including 76% of Democrats and 80% of Republicans.

stories.title: Left and right oppose artificial intelligence data centers
stories.teaser: Artificial intelligence data centers are sparking rare bipartisan opposition across the country, uniting conservatives, environmental groups, and concerned citizens against rapid development. In Nebraska, farmers and the Sierra Club opposed a potential data center project in Murdock, while New Mexico faces similar concerns about Project Jupiter, a $165 billion complex near the Mexican border.

stories.title: Beyond Chatbots: How Two Indian Tech Innovators Built the World's First 'Honest AI' Grounded in Ancient Philosophy
stories.teaser: Two Indian technology entrepreneurs, Satyavrat Nirala and Naveen Babu Garikapati, have created HiMirrorly.com, a digital platform designed to prioritize human and emotional intelligence over artificial intelligence. Unlike mainstream AI chatbots that provide fluent but often unverified answers, HiMirrorly.com functions as a digital mirror that reflects users' own words back to them and refuses to guess or claim…

stories.title: CEP, IIT Delhi Opens Admissions for Fourth Batch of Certificate Programme in Applied Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
stories.teaser: IIT Delhi's Continuing Education Programme has opened admissions for the fourth batch of its eight-month online Certificate Programme in Applied Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. The program, offering over 300 hours of learning, is designed for professionals seeking to develop skills in data science and AI across various industries including healthcare, banking, retail and manufacturing.

stories.title: Bill Gates diagnoses problems with AI, but an expert questions his prescription
stories.teaser: Bill Gates has published a lengthy essay warning that artificial intelligence development poses unprecedented risks to society, potentially creating massive unemployment and economic turmoil if left unchecked. The Microsoft co-founder argues that world leaders must immediately collaborate to address AI's dangers, including the possibility of criminals gaining access to the technology.

stories.title: Update: China unveils roadmap for AI, NEV industrial upgrading
stories.teaser: China has announced a comprehensive industrial upgrade plan for 2026-2030 that includes nearly 200 artificial intelligence standards and the construction of 500 zero-carbon factories. Government officials revealed that AI has been integrated throughout China's industrial chain, from research to maintenance operations.

stories.title: Bridging India's AI Skill Gap: How Ivy Professional School Replaces Portfolio Projects with Real Production AI
stories.teaser: Ivy Professional School, an AI and data science training organization in India, distinguishes itself by having students work on real business projects rather than portfolio assignments. One Fortune 100 heavy engineering company saved eight million dollars over eight months through AI initiatives developed with the school, while a steel manufacturer's team built and deployed over ten internal machine learning…

stories.title: Ireland ranks 2nd in EU for AI skills and jobs, report shows
stories.teaser: A new report from the Expert Group on Future Skills Needs shows that Ireland is experiencing strong growth in artificial intelligence jobs and skills, ranking second in the European Union behind only Luxembourg. The research found that Ireland is generating AI jobs at two to three times the rate of other EU countries, with a robust talent pipeline and substantial demand for workers with AI expertise.

stories.title: IITM Pravartak Announces Batch 03 of Advanced Certificate in Applied Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
stories.teaser: IITM Pravartak, the technology innovation hub of IIT Madras, has partnered with TimesPro to launch the third batch of its Advanced Certificate in Applied Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning program. The seven-month online course targets professionals who want to build practical skills in designing and deploying AI systems for real business applications across sectors including retail, finance, healthcare and…

stories.title: Artificial intelligence can strengthen citizen participation
stories.teaser: The Bertelsmann Stiftung and OECD released a new policy brief examining 50 case studies from 22 countries to show how artificial intelligence can improve citizen participation in government. The research demonstrates that AI can make participation more inclusive, accessible, and scalable through various applications such as analyzing large volumes of citizen input, operating chatbots, providing translation…

incidents.title: Round Hill is suing Suno and Anthropic for up to $1B apiece. It isn’t looking to settle.
incidents.teaser: Major record labels including Universal Music Group, Sony Music, Warner Music, Capitol Records, and Atlantic Records have filed separate lawsuits against Udio and Suno, two popular AI music generators. The labels accuse both companies of scraping thousands of copyrighted songs without permission to train their models and of directly reproducing sections of famous recordings in their generated music.

incidents.title: Sony Music moves to add more than 30,000 copyrighted recordings to its lawsuit against Udio
incidents.teaser: Universal Music Group has settled a lawsuit against AI music startup Udio, reaching licensing agreements to end the dispute over copyrighted music used to train the company's artificial intelligence model. UMG had accused Udio of using hits like The Temptations' "My Girl" to create similar songs without permission or compensation.

incidents.title: A Pizza Hut franchisee is suing over a forced AI system it says wrecked deliveries
incidents.teaser: # Summary A major Pizza Hut franchisee has filed a lawsuit in Texas claiming the chain's mandatory adoption of Dragontail, an AI-powered delivery-management system, caused over 100 million dollars in damages. Chaac Pizza Northeast, which operates approximately 111 Pizza Hut restaurants across five northeastern states, alleges that the system created cascading operational failures after it gave DoorDash drivers…

incidents.title: Sleep Staging Is Not Guesswork
incidents.teaser: A lawsuit filed by Clarkson Law Firm in San Francisco accuses Oura, a smart ring company valued at $11 billion, of false advertising regarding its sleep tracking capabilities. The suit alleges that Oura's rings, priced at $300 and up, cannot accurately measure different sleep stages as the company claims.

incidents.title: ASIC warns scammers are using AI to spin vast webs of deception
incidents.teaser: # Summary A fake online article featured a fabricated interview between ABC finance presenter Alan Kohler and Reserve Bank governor Michele Bullock discussing Boulder Sparhaven, an unlicensed cryptocurrency trading platform. The article never happened but was created using artificial intelligence technology.

incidents.title: Caught in 4K: The Aurora Files
incidents.teaser: Gambit Security's Threat Intelligence team identified the Aurora ransomware group actively targeting ESXi environments with a specialized Linux variant since April 2026. The attackers deployed ransomware that encrypts virtual machine files while keeping the hypervisor bootable so victims can see ransom demands.
